comments.author: @angelabluebird609
comments.text: Yes, it  is very upsetting. Not everyone in South Carolina is racist. Depends on the area, to some degree. Yes, the area you mention is not known for be inclusive. I'm from SC, and have returned after many years. The more inclusive, forward thinking folks continuously work hard for change. She can find and join them, for friendships and perhaps join the work for social change. Try to locate individual, small produce sellers. I'm relatively close, in Greenville. There are many places to buy better produce. There are farmer's markets where small sellers gather to sell their produce, local honey, baked goods, meats, cheeses, etc. Many sellers use their carports, with a scale, money box and the honor system. Lastly, racism it not confined to the South. It is nationwide-and un-American.
